evidence: The development and use of AI, including by third parties, presents risks and challenges that may adversely impact M&T.

The legal and regulatory environment relating to AI is uncertain and rapidly evolving, and includes regulation targeted specifically at AI as well as provisions in intellectual property, privacy, consumer protection, employment and other laws applicable to the use of AI.

AI models, including generative AI models may produce output or influence the Company or its third-party service providers to take actions that are incorrect, that result in the release of private, confidential or proprietary information, that reflect biases included in the data on which they are trained.

The complexity of certain AI models makes it challenging to understand why they are generating particular outputs. This limited transparency increases the challenges associated with assessing the proper operation of AI models.
The Company may rely on AI models developed by third parties, and, to that extent, would be dependent in part on the manner in which those third parties develop and train their models.
ai_positioning.summary: MTB adopte une posture défensive face à l'IA, mettant l'accent sur les risques réglementaires, opérationnels et de conformité liés à l'utilisation de l'IA en interne et par des tiers, sans mentionner de développement ou d'intégration stratégique.

company_description: M&T Bank Corporation operates as a bank holding company for Manufacturers and Traders Trust Company and Wilmington Trust, National Association that provides retail and commercial banking products and services in the United States. The company operates through three segments: Commercial Bank, Retail Bank, and Institutional Services and Wealth Management. It offers a range of credit products and banking services, such as commercial lending and leasing, letters of credits, deposit products, cash management services, commercial real estate loans, and credit facilities secured by various commercial real estate properties to middle-market and large commercial customers. The company also provides customers deposit products, including demand, savings and time accounts, and other services; automobile and recreational finance loans, home equity loans and lines of credit, credit cards, and other loan products, as well as residential mortgage and real estate loans; business loans, cash management, payroll, direct deposit, and merchant credit card services to consumers and small businesses through branch network, telephone banking, internet banking, and automated teller machines. In addition, it offers trustee, agency, investment management, and administrative services; personal trust, planning and advisory, fiduciary, asset management, family office, and other services; and investment products, including mutual funds and annuities, and other services for corporations and institutions, investment bankers, corporate tax, finance and legal executives, and other institutional clients. M&T Bank Corporation was founded in 1856 and is headquartered in Buffalo, New York.

risks_rationale_fr.0: Risque positionné en début de section Risk Factors avec langage fort ('could adversely affect'). Langage d'intensité élevée soulignant l'imprévisibilité et les pertes potentiellement 'significantly' supérieures aux provisions. Tendance stable mais risque structurel permanent. Catégorie litige = poids fort en secteur financier.
risks_rationale_fr.1: Risque identifié en début de section avec langage modéré ('could materially impact'). Analyse de sensibilité effectuée (hausse 100 pb des taux) sans impairment détecté, suggérant une atténuation relative. Goodwill représente 8,465 M$ (4% des actifs moyens). Tendance atténuée par tests de sensibilité rassurants.
risks_rationale_fr.2: Risque explicitement listé dans forward-looking statements comme facteur clé ('changes in interest rates, spreads on earning assets'). Langage d'intensité modérée mais impact direct sur marges nettes (NIM = 3,69% Q4 2025). Tendance stable mais sensibilité structurelle élevée. Poids macro = fort pour banque.
risks_rationale_fr.3: Risque explicitement mentionné dans forward-looking statements ('operational risk events, including loss resulting from fraud by employees or persons outside M&T and breaches in data and cybersecurity'). Langage d'intensité modérée mais catégorie cybersécurité = poids fort en régulation financière. Tendance stable mais menace croissante structurelle. Positionné parmi facteurs clés.
risks_rationale_fr.4: Risque listé en premier des facteurs forward-looking ('economic conditions and growth rates, including inflation and market volatility'). Langage d'intensité modérée mais impact systémique sur tous les segments. Tendance stable mais contexte macro actuel tendu. Poids macro = fort pour institution financière.
risks_rationale_fr.5: Risque explicitement cité ('federal, state or local legislation and/or regulations affecting the financial services industry' et 'regulatory supervision and oversight, including monetary policy and capital requirements'). Langage d'intensité modérée mais impact direct sur rentabilité et structure du bilan. Tendance stable mais pression réglementaire croissante. Catégorie régulation = poids fort.
risks_rationale_fr.6: Risque listé dans forward-looking statements ('increasing price, product and service competition by competitors, including new entrants'). Langage d'intensité modérée. Tendance stable mais pression concurrentielle structurelle croissante (fintech, néobanques). Catégorie concurrence = poids moyen.
risks_rationale_fr.7: Risque explicitement mentionné ('domestic or international political developments and other geopolitical events, including trade and tariff policies and international conflicts and hostilities'). Langage d'intensité modérée. Tendance nouvelle/accrue (conflits internationaux actuels). Poids géopolitique = moyen pour banque régionale US.
